name: Parts and Pieces

angles.text: Engineers may see the irony in pirates taking apart a sophisticated machine. Wrenix's scattered parts show the danger of sending an automated prototype into a hostile camp without physical safeguards.

faq.answer: Wrenix the Wretched is an eccentric tinkerer in the port town of Ratchet. After five or six mercenaries failed to return alive from the pirates south of town, he sent an automated machine to face them. The pirates dismantled it, and its parts lie scattered in their upper camp.

aliases: what happened to the other adventurers
faq.answer: Wrenix hired five or six mercenaries to deal with the pirates south of Ratchet. None returned alive, so he turned to a machine instead.
faq.q: What happened to the earlier mercenaries Wrenix hired?

aliases: why did wrenix use a contraption
faq.answer: Wrenix sent a machine because five or six mercenaries he hired failed to return alive. He hoped an automated contraption could face the pirates without risking another living soul.
faq.q: Why did Wrenix send a machine to fight the pirates?

aliases: how did pirates dismantle the robot
faq.answer: The pirates used their curved scimitars as makeshift screwdrivers to pry Wrenix's machine apart. They scattered its components through their camp and dismantled the contraption down to its frame before Wrenix could send it instructions to retreat toward Ratchet.
faq.q: How did the pirates dismantle Wrenix's machine?

faq.answer: The complicated parts lie scattered on the ground in the pirates' upper camp along the coast south of Ratchet. They left the pieces there after taking Wrenix's machine apart. Five handfuls must be gathered.
faq.q: Where are the complicated parts located?

aliases: why does wrenix think you will survive
faq.answer: Wrenix believes gathering scattered parts is safer than sending mercenaries to eliminate the pirates. The earlier mercenaries did not return alive; this work calls for slipping into the upper camp and collecting five handfuls of components from the dirt.
faq.q: Why does Wrenix believe this retrieval mission is safer?

aliases: why does wrenix need the parts
what does wrenix do with the parts
faq.answer: The complicated parts are pieces of Wrenix's automated machine. He needs them recovered so his engineering work and materials do not go entirely to waste.
faq.q: What are the Complicated Parts needed for?

sections.body:
Pirates along the coast south of Ratchet trouble the town's residents and tradesfolk. Wrenix the Wretched wanted to stop them without risking more coin on hired hands. Five or six mercenaries had already gone after the pirates and failed to return alive.

So Wrenix sent an automated machine to deal with the encampment on its own. He hoped the contraption could face the marauders without putting another living soul at risk.
sections.title: A Mechanical Solution

sections.body:
The pirates south of Ratchet proved resourceful. They used their curved scimitars as makeshift screwdrivers and pried Wrenix's machine apart before he could send instructions to retreat toward town.

Its delicate components now lie scattered in their upper camp. Wrenix needs someone to slip inside and gather five handfuls of the complicated parts from the dirt.
sections.title: Scimitars and Screwdrivers

summary: In Ratchet, Wrenix's machine lies in pieces after the pirates dismantled it. He sent it to face the raiders after five or six mercenaries failed to return alive. Now its scattered parts lie in the pirates' upper camp.
